metadata.note: Historical candidate is not approved as final metadata. Do not use for deployment until corrected metadata is published and independently verified.

existing_contract_candidate.note: Previously recorded address. Do not represent as the newly deployed contract or assume it is compatible until chain code, source, and permissions are inspected.

latest_deployment_attempt.interpretation: Errors alone do not prove whether a transaction was broadcast or a contract was deployed. Check wallet activity and explorer receipts before retrying.

next_steps: Inspect the existing contract address on Ethereum Mainnet and confirm bytecode, verified source, standard interface, owner, and mint permissions.

Publish the reviewed corrected metadata JSON to IPFS and verify the new CID through independent gateways.
Reconcile the artwork byte-hash mismatch and confirm the intended recipient wallet.
